info.title: InSTEDD Resource Map REST API
info.description: Resource Map (InSTEDD) maps facilities and resources as *sites* grouped into *collections*; each collection defines its own *layers* of *fields*, and layer membership is also the unit of read/write permission. This document covers the whole `/api` surface of the open-source Rails application. Routes carry a format suffix (`.json`, and `.rss`/`.csv` where the server renders them). The OpenFn resourcemap adaptor reaches this API over HTTP Basic auth; its one named operation, `submitSite`, posts to `/api/collections/{id}/sites.json`, and its inherited generic builders can reach every other endpoint here.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic with a Resource Map user's email and password. InSTEDD deployments may also accept a GUISSO single sign-on session.

page.name: page
page.description: Page number, or the literal `all` to disable paging.

search.name: search
search.description: Full-text search across site names and property values.

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Field code to sort by (`name`, `lat`, `lng`, `created_at`, `updated_at` or a field code).

box.name: box
box.description: Bounding box as four comma-separated numbers: west,south,east,north.

lat.name: lat
lat.description: Latitude of a radius search centre. Requires `lng` and `radius`.

lng.name: lng
lng.description: Longitude of a radius search centre. Requires `lat` and `radius`.

updatedSince.name: updated_since
updatedSince.description: Only sites updated at or after this time.

deletedSince.name: deleted_since
deletedSince.description: Return sites deleted at or after this time.

fieldsParam.name: fields
fieldsParam.description: Comma-separated list of field codes to include in each site's properties.

human.name: human
human.description: `true` to render property values as human-readable labels instead of codes.

siteId.name: site_id
siteId.description: Restrict the query to one site id.

Collection.description: A Resource Map collection: a named set of sites with its own layers and field definitions.

count.description: Number of sites in the collection.

public.description: Whether the collection has a public layer.

Site.description: A site (a mapped resource/facility) as returned by the query API.

deletedAt.description: Present only for sites returned by a deleted_since query.

properties.description: Field values keyed by field code (or numeric field id when codes are not used).

groups.description: Group memberships, when the collection uses them.

SiteRecord.description: A site as returned by the write endpoints (create, update, partial_update, update_property): the raw Site record rather than the query-API projection.

properties.description: Field values keyed by the internal es_code of each field.

SiteHistory.description: One stored version of a site. Resource Map writes a history row on every change; each row holds the complete site, not just the changed values.

version.description: Autoincrementing version number of this site.

valid_to.description: When this version stopped being current; null for the current version.

user.description: Email of the user who made this change.

Field.description: A field definition inside a layer. `kind` drives which extra config keys are present.

code.description: Stable code used as the key in a site's `properties`.

config.description: Kind-specific configuration (option lists, hierarchy trees, ranges).

Layer.description: A layer: a named group of field definitions within a collection. Layer membership is also the unit of read/write permission.

FieldMapping.description: Compact name/code/kind mapping for every field in a collection.

SiteReference.description: A site referenced from a permission list.

SitePermission.description: Which sites a membership grants access to.

Membership.description: A user's membership of a collection and the layer/site permissions it carries.

user_display_name.description: Display name (the user's email in most deployments).

AuthenticationToken.description: The current user's long-lived API authentication token.

CollectionSites.description: A page of the sites in a collection, as returned by the collection query endpoint.

previousPage.description: Absolute URL of the previous page; absent on the first page.

nextPage.description: Absolute URL of the next page; absent on the last page.

SiteFeature.description: One site as a GeoJSON Feature.

CollectionGeoJson.description: A page of a collection's geolocated sites, wrapped as a GeoJSON Feature whose properties carry the FeatureCollection plus paging info.

Histogram.description: Site counts bucketed by the values of one field. Keys are the field's option ids (or values); values are counts.

SiteInput.description: Site payload. Resource Map reads it from a `site` request parameter holding a JSON document; the OpenFn adaptor sends that JSON as the request body with a `content-disposition: form-data; name="site"` header.

properties.description: Field values keyed by field code or es_code.

LayerInput.description: Layer payload for create/update. Wrapped in a `layer` key.

FieldsInput.description: Fields to add to a layer.

MembershipInput.description: Invite an existing Resource Map user to a collection.

LayerAccessInput.description: Grant or revoke a membership's access to one layer.

UpdatePropertyInput.description: Set a single field value on a site.

es_code.description: Internal field code (or field code) of the property to set.

value.description: New value; type depends on the field kind. Send an empty string to clear it.

BulkUpdateInput.description: Apply the same changes to every site matching the query filters passed as query parameters.

Error.description: Error envelope used by every /api endpoint.
